rules.condition: advisory invocation arguments are not the closed --invocation form
rules.nextAction: use exactly --invocation followed by one task-local manifest path

rules.condition: advisory execution encountered a non-contract failure
rules.nextAction: correct the local runtime failure without treating it as a conformance result

rules.condition: conformance input identities or relationships are malformed
rules.nextAction: rebuild canonical inputs from their owners

rules.condition: record contains a derived-only field
rules.nextAction: remove the derived field and rerun validation

rules.condition: external observation attempts lifecycle promotion
rules.nextAction: retain it only as an untrusted observation

rules.condition: field map has a gap, overlap, or wildcard
rules.nextAction: repair the exact profile map

rules.condition: handoff derivation lacks a valid conformance identity
rules.nextAction: rerun conformance before deriving handoff

rules.condition: correlated identities disagree
rules.nextAction: refresh the earliest owner identity

rules.condition: an advisory input exceeds the profile-owned bound
rules.nextAction: reduce the owner-produced input within the closed bound

rules.condition: local record duplicates ChangeIntentEnvelope facts
rules.nextAction: reference the canonical envelope or use the pre-G1.9 incomplete path set

rules.condition: the advisory invocation or one preimage is malformed, missing, or noncanonical
rules.nextAction: rebuild the task-local invocation from canonical owner bytes

rules.condition: the advisory invocation binds stale authority, contract, source, or preimage identity
rules.nextAction: rebuild the invocation against the current accepted candidate

rules.condition: an advisory locator escapes its task-local invocation directory
rules.nextAction: use a confined relative locator with no traversal or symlink escape

rules.condition: owner reference cannot resolve at installed-local source
rules.nextAction: restore or update the pinned owner record

rules.condition: packet identity or payload relation is invalid
rules.nextAction: rerender from the validated record

rules.condition: disclosure owner rejects material
rules.nextAction: remove disallowed material and renew disclosure

rules.condition: profile or profile version is unsupported
rules.nextAction: migrate to a supported profile

rules.condition: reviewer dependencies are incomplete, contradictory, or unknown
rules.nextAction: invalidate the packet and all dependent reviews and acceptance

rules.condition: filesystem rollback is complete but the retained Decision 0009 continuation binds the prior source and no later accepted authority permits another successor
rules.nextAction: obtain a new digest-specific owner decision, append one uniquely versioned continuation, and run fresh full checks

rules.condition: rollback postconditions are incomplete or ambiguous
rules.nextAction: run the derived idempotent next command

rules.condition: record violates the closed private schema
rules.nextAction: correct the record at its owning field

rules.condition: identifier is not admitted by the profile
rules.nextAction: use an admitted owner or command reference

rules.condition: worktree or changed-path confinement is invalid
rules.nextAction: restore the recorded base and write-set confinement
